Passive network implant that does not interfere with legitimate traffic unless triggered
Injected via .NET app, VB script, or executable with shellcode
No need for command and control servers; uses NetAgent listener in legitimate processes

Injection into legitimate network listening processes on various ports (DNS over TCP 53, HTTP 80, HTTPS 443, RDP 3389, Windows Remote Management 5985)

Indicators of Compromise: Eight infected IP addresses belonging to a single Asian mobile hardware and software manufacturer
